def test_row_length_exceeds_page_size_raises():
    """Test that row_length overflow raises ValueError instead of segfaulting (GH#66475)."""
    import io
    import struct
    from pathlib import Path
    
    test_data_dir = Path(__file__).parent / "data"
    
    # Test case 1: test1.sas7bdat (32-bit uncompressed)
    # Set row_length to 0x7FFFFFF0 at offset 130612 to trigger int overflow
    with open(test_data_dir / "test1.sas7bdat", "rb") as f:
        data = bytearray(f.read())
    
    # Replace row_length with 0x7FFFFFF0 (will overflow C int)
    data[130612:130616] = (0x7FFFFFF0).to_bytes(4, 'little')
    
    # This should raise ValueError, not segfault
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"row_length.*exceeds the page size"):
        pd.read_sas(io.BytesIO(bytes(data)), format="sas7bdat", encoding=None)
    
    # Test case 2: test2.sas7bdat (32-bit RLE compressed)
    with open(test_data_dir / "test2.sas7bdat", "rb") as f:
        data = bytearray(f.read())
    
    data[130612:130616] = (0x7FFFFFF0).to_bytes(4, 'little')
    
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"row_length.*exceeds the page size"):
        pd.read_sas(io.BytesIO(bytes(data)), format="sas7bdat", encoding=None)
    
    # Test case 3: test7.sas7bdat (64-bit)
    with open(test_data_dir / "test7.sas7bdat", "rb") as f:
        data = bytearray(f.read())
    
    # For 64-bit, row_length is 8 bytes
    data[130304:130312] = (0x7FFFFFF0).to_bytes(8, 'little')
    
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"row_length.*exceeds the page size"):
        pd.read_sas(io.BytesIO(bytes(data)), format="sas7bdat", encoding=None)
EOF
